title: Quality Differentiation and Matching Performance in Peer-to-Peer Markets: Evidence from Airbnb Plus
eligible_reason: Replication-stage verification (data/replication_logs/mnsc.2020.03920.md): every reported column includes nine time-varying ACS controls
design_notes: airbnbplus_results_rep.do, data airbnbplus_data.dta (14,604 zip-months; 773 zips; timeperiod 8-34; 161 treated zips; policy_entry never switches off). Table 4: average_booked_nights on policy_entry + acs_ctrls + i.timeperiod, xtreg fe cluster(zipcode), unweighted (col 1) and with CEM weights [aweight=total_weights] (col 2; 586 zips have positive weight). Table 5: relative-time model with relative_time_m4..m2, _0, p1..p4 (m1 omitted) + controls. Tables 6-7: heterogeneity by market thickness / rating dispersion (policy_entry_low_x, policy_entry_high_x, controls interacted). Tables 8-9: plus_booking, close2plus_booking, regular_booking, plus_price, close2plus_price, regular_price with controls, unweighted and weighted. Appendix: A15 did_multiplegt average_booked_nights zipcode timeperiod policy_entry, controls(acs_ctrls) robust_dynamic dynamic(4) placebo(4); A19 city-clustered SEs; A20 log outcomes; A21 city trends. Abstract: 15.8%-16.2% increase in booked nights.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Computed from airbnbplus_data.dta: first month with policy_entry == 1 by zip code takes six distinct values (14, 22, 23, 26, 28, 32); two large cohorts (29 and 127 zips) and four tiny ones. 612 never-treated zips.
modern_estimators_named: de_chaisemartin_dhaultfoeuille (did_multiplegt, with controls; appendix Table A15)
data_files: paper_results.log (full Stata log of all tables)
data_files_note: Zip-code-level panel complete; listing-level data for Table 2 and Tables A4-A5 not included (available on request per readme).
software_notes: Stata xtreg fe with i.timeperiod, asdoc, outreg, did_multiplegt.
priority_note: Borderline: staggered binary design with never-treated units and complete data, but no reported specification is free of time-varying controls. Flag for the lead in case the project decides to re-estimate Table 4 without acs_ctrls.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Treatment timing, switch-off behaviour (none) and control variation checked directly in airbnbplus_data.dta with pandas. Table 3 balance checks and Tables 6-7 heterogeneity (policy_entry_low/high_thickness, policy_entry_low/high_dispersion with controls interacted by group) are also ineligible (subgroup-by-treatment interactions).

ineligible_specs.notes: Endpoints not binned beyond +/-4 (indicators for m4..p4 only).

ineligible_specs.outcome: plus_booking, close2plus_booking, regular_booking (Table 8); plus_price, close2plus_price, regular_price (Table 9)
